title: 橢圓偏光儀建置~Ellipsometer construction
focus: 從 Ψ/Δ 與菲涅耳反演到偏光元件、測角儀與擬合的橢偏儀建置~From Ψ/Δ and Fresnel inversion to polarizing optics, goniometer and model fitting in ellipsometer construction
summary: 以反射偏振比 ρ = tanΨ·e^{iΔ} 為核心，說明橢圓偏光儀為何能把薄膜厚度量到次埃，再逐步建置光源、偏光鏡、補償器、測角儀與旋轉檢偏鏡，並用 SiO₂/Si 參考片把校正、參數相關性、視窗雙折射與量規重複性整合成可交接的儀器。~Built around the reflection polarization ratio ρ = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, this course explains why an ellipsometer resolves film thickness to sub-ångström level, then assembles source, polarizer, compensator, goniometer and rotating analyzer step by step, using SiO₂/Si reference wafers to tie calibration, parameter correlation, window birefringence and gauge repeatability into a hand-over-ready instrument.

units.anchor: 反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角~Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence
units.title: 橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界~Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries
units.mechanism: 橢圓偏光儀不量反射率的絕對值，而是量 p 偏振與 s 偏振反射係數的複數比 ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}：Ψ 描述振幅比、Δ 描述相位差。因為是比值，光源強度漂移、偵測器增益變化與視窗穿透率都在第一階消去，這是它能把薄膜厚度解析到 0.01 nm 等級的根本原因。入射角選在基板布魯斯特角附近時 r_p 最小而 ρ 對薄膜最敏感；對矽（633 nm 時 n ≈ 3.88）布魯斯特角約 75.5°，所以商用儀器多在 65–75° 工作。系統邊界是：一束已知偏振的準直光、一個角度已知的反射面、一個能解出偏振態的分析臂。~An ellipsometer does not measure absolute reflectance but the complex ratio of the p- and s-polarized reflection coefficients, ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, where Ψ describes the amplitude ratio and Δ the phase difference. Because it is a ratio, source drift, detector gain changes and window transmission cancel to first order, which is the root reason the technique resolves film thickness at the 0.01 nm level. Choosing the angle of incidence near the substrate's Brewster angle minimises r_p and maximises the sensitivity of ρ to a film; for silicon (n ≈ 3.88 at 633 nm) the Brewster angle is about 75.5°, so commercial instruments work at 65–75°. The system boundary is a collimated beam of known polarization, a reflecting surface at a known angle, and an analysis arm able to solve for the polarization state.
units.model: 裸基板可直接反演：⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]。在 φ = 70°、632.8 nm 下量到 Ψ = 10.57°、Δ = 179.23°，代入得 ⟨ε⟩ = 15.07 − 0.148i，開根號得 n = 3.882、k = 0.019，正是矽在此波長的光學常數；布魯斯特角 arctan(3.882) = 75.5°。~A bare substrate inverts directly: ⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]. Measuring Ψ = 10.57° and Δ = 179.23° at φ = 70° and 632.8 nm gives ⟨ε⟩ = 15.07 − 0.148i, whose square root is n = 3.882, k = 0.019, the optical constants of silicon at that wavelength; the Brewster angle is arctan(3.882) = 75.5°.
units.verify: 用一片剛去除原生氧化層的矽片（或以已知 1.5–2 nm 原生氧化層建模）在 60°、65°、70°、75° 四個角度量 Ψ、Δ，各自反演出 ⟨ε⟩；若四組 n、k 一致到小數第二位，表示入射角、偏光鏡方位與偵測器線性都正確，否則角度相依的差異會直接指出哪個元件有系統誤差。~Measure Ψ and Δ on a silicon wafer with its native oxide freshly removed (or modelled as a known 1.5–2 nm layer) at 60°, 65°, 70° and 75° and invert each to ⟨ε⟩; if the four n, k pairs agree to the second decimal, angle of incidence, polarizer azimuth and detector linearity are all correct, otherwise the angle-dependent discrepancy points directly at the element carrying a systematic error.
units.failure: 把橢偏儀當反射率計使用、拿單一角度的強度訊號推薄膜厚度，光源 1% 的漂移就會變成奈米級厚度誤差；真正的橢偏量測必須建立在 Ψ、Δ 這兩個比值型觀測量之上。~Using the ellipsometer as a reflectometer and inferring thickness from single-angle intensity turns a 1% source drift into nanometre-scale thickness error; a genuine ellipsometric measurement must rest on the ratio-type observables Ψ and Δ.
units.misconception: 橢偏儀量的是反射光強度，所以光源越穩定厚度越準。~An ellipsometer measures reflected intensity, so a more stable source gives more accurate thickness.

units.anchor: SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型~Fresnel–Airy model of SiO₂/Si films
units.title: 菲涅耳係數、薄膜干涉與厚度靈敏度~Fresnel coefficients, thin-film interference and thickness sensitivity
units.mechanism: 單層薄膜的反射係數由兩個界面的菲涅耳係數與膜內相位厚度 β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ) 組成：r = (r₀₁ + r₁₂e^{−2iβ})/(1 + r₀₁r₁₂e^{−2iβ})，p 與 s 各算一次再取比值得到 ρ(d, n₁, n₂, φ, λ)。量測得到 Ψ、Δ 之後，厚度與折射率是以模型擬合反解，而不是直接讀出。對很薄的膜，Δ 對厚度的靈敏度極高而 Ψ 幾乎不動；膜厚增加到數十奈米後 Ψ 開始承擔厚度資訊；當 β 累積到 π 時 Ψ、Δ 回到起點，產生厚度週期性的多解。~A single film's reflection coefficient combines the Fresnel coefficients of its two interfaces with the film phase thickness β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ): r = (r₀₁ + r₁₂e^{−2iβ})/(1 + r₀₁r₁₂e^{−2iβ}), evaluated for p and s and then ratioed to give ρ(d, n₁, n₂, φ, λ). Thickness and index are recovered by fitting this model to the measured Ψ and Δ, not read directly. For very thin films Δ is extremely sensitive to thickness while Ψ hardly moves; beyond a few tens of nanometres Ψ takes over the thickness information; and once β accumulates to π, Ψ and Δ return to their starting values, producing periodic thickness ambiguity.
units.model: SiO₂（n₁ = 1.457）在 Si 上、φ = 70°、λ = 632.8 nm 的厚度週期為 d_p = λ/(2√(n₁² − sin²φ)) = 632.8/(2×1.1135) = 284 nm。由模型計算：d → 0 時 dΔ/dd = −2.86°/nm、dΨ/dd ≈ 0.014°/nm；d = 100 nm 時 Ψ = 41.06°、Δ = 79.79°，dΨ/dd = 0.55°/nm、dΔ/dd = 0.063°/nm。若儀器的 Ψ、Δ 解析度為 0.01°，原生氧化層的厚度解析度約 0.0035 nm，100 nm 膜約 0.02 nm。~For SiO₂ (n₁ = 1.457) on Si at φ = 70° and λ = 632.8 nm the thickness period is d_p = λ/(2√(n₁² − sin²φ)) = 632.8/(2×1.1135) = 284 nm. The model gives dΔ/dd = −2.86°/nm and dΨ/dd ≈ 0.014°/nm as d → 0, while at d = 100 nm, Ψ = 41.06°, Δ = 79.79°, dΨ/dd = 0.55°/nm and dΔ/dd = 0.063°/nm. With 0.01° resolution in Ψ and Δ, the thickness resolution is about 0.0035 nm for a native oxide and about 0.02 nm for a 100 nm film.
units.verify: 取一組熱氧化矽片（標稱 2、25、100、300 nm），在 70° 量 Ψ、Δ 並以單層模型擬合；把擬合值畫在 Ψ–Δ 軌跡圖上，確認它們落在模型曲線上且 300 nm 樣品落在第二週期；再把 100 nm 片在 65° 與 75° 重量，確認擬合厚度在 0.1 nm 內一致。~Take a set of thermally oxidised wafers (nominal 2, 25, 100 and 300 nm), measure Ψ and Δ at 70° and fit a single-layer model; plot the results on the Ψ–Δ trajectory to confirm they lie on the model curve with the 300 nm sample in the second period, then remeasure the 100 nm wafer at 65° and 75° and confirm the fitted thickness agrees within 0.1 nm.
units.failure: 單波長、單角度量測一片 384 nm 的氧化層，擬合報出 100 nm 且 MSE 極小，因為兩者相差剛好一個週期；沒有光譜或多角度資訊時這個錯誤無法從數據本身察覺。~A single-wavelength, single-angle measurement of a 384 nm oxide fits as 100 nm with a tiny MSE because the two differ by exactly one period; without spectroscopic or multi-angle data the error cannot be detected from the data themselves.
units.misconception: Ψ 與 Δ 和厚度是一一對應的，所以一個波長就能唯一決定厚度。~Ψ and Δ map one-to-one to thickness, so a single wavelength determines it uniquely.

units.anchor: 格蘭—泰勒偏光鏡與 MgF₂ 補償器~Glan–Taylor polarizers and the MgF₂ compensator
units.title: 光源、偏光元件與補償器~Source, polarizing optics and the compensator
units.mechanism: 光譜型橢偏儀的光源常用 75 W 氙燈或氘燈加鹵素燈，覆蓋 190–1700 nm；單波長儀器用氦氖雷射或 LED。偏光鏡與檢偏鏡用方解石格蘭—泰勒稜鏡，消光比可達 10⁻⁵–10⁻⁶，深紫外改用 MgF₂ 羅瓊稜鏡。補償器是一片提供約四分之一波相位延遲的雙折射波片，讓儀器在 Δ 接近 0° 或 180° 時仍有相位靈敏度；旋轉補償器型（RCE）用它作為調制元件，並藉由 Δ 的正負號辨識消除 RAE 的符號模糊。偵測端以光柵光譜儀配 Si CCD 與 InGaAs 陣列同時讀出數百個波長。~A spectroscopic ellipsometer typically uses a 75 W xenon lamp or deuterium plus halogen lamps covering 190–1700 nm, while single-wavelength instruments use a HeNe laser or LED. Polarizer and analyzer are calcite Glan–Taylor prisms with extinction ratios of 10⁻⁵–10⁻⁶, replaced by MgF₂ Rochon prisms in the deep ultraviolet. The compensator is a birefringent plate providing roughly quarter-wave retardance so that the instrument keeps phase sensitivity when Δ approaches 0° or 180°; a rotating-compensator ellipsometer (RCE) uses it as the modulating element and resolves the sign of Δ that an RAE cannot. The detection end uses a grating spectrograph with Si CCD and InGaAs arrays to read hundreds of wavelengths at once.
units.model: MgF₂ 在 633 nm 的雙折射 Δn ≈ 0.0119，零級四分之一波片厚度 d = λ/(4Δn) = 632.8/(4×0.0119) ≈ 13.3 µm（實務上以兩片相減成零級組合）。忽略色散時延遲量 ∝ 1/λ：400 nm 處約 0.25×632.8/400 = 0.40 波（142°），1000 nm 處 0.16 波（57°）；RCE 的演算法只要求延遲落在約 60°–300° 之間，所以單一波片可覆蓋 400–1000 nm 的量測。~MgF₂ has a birefringence Δn ≈ 0.0119 at 633 nm, so a zero-order quarter-wave plate is d = λ/(4Δn) = 632.8/(4×0.0119) ≈ 13.3 µm thick (in practice made as a subtractive two-plate zero-order pair). Ignoring dispersion the retardance scales as 1/λ: about 0.25×632.8/400 = 0.40 wave (142°) at 400 nm and 0.16 wave (57°) at 1000 nm; because the RCE algorithm only needs retardance between about 60° and 300°, one plate covers measurements from 400 to 1000 nm.
units.verify: 以直通配置（不放樣品、光源臂與偵測臂對直）量偏光鏡—檢偏鏡的消光曲線，擬合 cos² 得到消光比，確認優於 10⁻⁵；再把補償器放入並旋轉，量各波長的延遲量並與 1/λ 趨勢比較，記錄成補償器的波長校正表供軟體使用。~In the straight-through configuration (no sample, source and detector arms aligned) measure the polarizer–analyzer extinction curve, fit a cos² law to obtain the extinction ratio and confirm it is better than 10⁻⁵; then insert and rotate the compensator, measure its retardance at each wavelength, compare with the 1/λ trend and record the result as the compensator calibration table used by the software.
units.failure: 用塑膠薄片偏光鏡取代稜鏡偏光鏡，消光比只有 10⁻³，殘餘的錯誤偏振分量使 Ψ 偏差 0.1° 以上，薄膜厚度出現固定偏置，且隨波長變化無法用單一常數校正。~Replacing prism polarizers with plastic sheet polarizers of only 10⁻³ extinction leaves a residual wrong-polarization component that biases Ψ by more than 0.1°, producing a fixed thickness offset that varies with wavelength and cannot be removed by a single constant.
units.misconception: 補償器只是讓訊號變大的選配件，旋轉檢偏鏡型儀器不需要它。~The compensator is an optional accessory to boost signal that a rotating-analyzer instrument never needs.

units.anchor: 雙臂測角儀與樣品台~Two-arm goniometer and sample stage
units.title: 測角儀機構、入射角與樣品對準~Goniometer mechanics, angle of incidence and sample alignment
units.mechanism: 光源臂與偵測臂裝在同軸的雙臂測角儀上，轉軸必須通過樣品表面：若樣品高度偏離轉軸，改變入射角時光點會在樣品上移動且反射光偏離偵測器。入射角由編碼器讀出並以直通位置（φ = 90°）歸零；樣品傾斜由四象限偵測器或自準直系統在量測前調平。因為 Δ 對入射角極度敏感，角度與傾斜的機械精度直接轉成薄膜參數的系統誤差，所以測角儀的軸承、編碼器與樣品台的 z 軸都屬於光學量測鏈的一部分。~Source and detector arms sit on a coaxial two-arm goniometer whose rotation axis must pass through the sample surface: if the sample height departs from the axis, the spot walks across the sample when the angle changes and the reflected beam leaves the detector. The angle of incidence is read from an encoder and zeroed at the straight-through position (φ = 90°); sample tilt is levelled before measurement with a quadrant detector or autocollimation. Because Δ is extremely sensitive to the angle of incidence, mechanical accuracy of angle and tilt converts directly into systematic film-parameter error, so the goniometer bearings, encoder and the z axis of the sample stage are part of the optical measurement chain.
units.model: 對 100 nm SiO₂/Si、70°、632.8 nm，模型給出 dΔ/dφ = −3.79°/度、dΨ/dφ = −0.043°/度：入射角若錯 0.1°，Δ 偏移 −0.38°，這相當於單靠 Δ 判讀時 6 nm 的厚度變化，而 Ψ 只動 −0.004°，兩者不再自洽，擬合的 MSE 會明顯升高。樣品傾斜 0.05° 使反射光偏 0.1° = 1.745 mrad，在 300 mm 的偵測臂上位移 0.52 mm，足以切到 1 mm 的偵測光闌。~For 100 nm SiO₂/Si at 70° and 632.8 nm the model gives dΔ/dφ = −3.79° per degree and dΨ/dφ = −0.043° per degree: a 0.1° angle error shifts Δ by −0.38°, equivalent to a 6 nm thickness change if read from Δ alone, while Ψ moves only −0.004°, so the two are no longer consistent and the fit MSE rises sharply. A 0.05° sample tilt deviates the reflected beam by 0.1° = 1.745 mrad, a 0.52 mm displacement on a 300 mm detector arm, enough to clip a 1 mm detector aperture.
units.verify: 以一片已知 100 nm 的熱氧化參考片在名義 70° 量測，把入射角當自由參數與厚度一起擬合；若擬合出的角度與編碼器讀值差超過 0.02°，就以自準直儀校正編碼器零點。接著以量規塊或雷射位移計檢查樣品台 z 軸與轉軸的重合度，要求優於 20 µm。~Measure a known 100 nm thermal-oxide reference at a nominal 70° and fit the angle of incidence as a free parameter together with thickness; if the fitted angle differs from the encoder reading by more than 0.02°, re-zero the encoder with an autocollimator. Then check the coincidence of the stage z axis with the rotation axis using gauge blocks or a laser displacement sensor, requiring better than 20 µm.
units.failure: 樣品台未調平、光點在偵測器光闌邊緣被部分遮擋時，被遮的部分因偏振相依的邊緣繞射改變了 p/s 比例，Ψ 出現 0.2–0.5° 的假偏移，厚度結果隨樣品放置位置而變。~With an unlevelled stage the spot is partially clipped at the detector aperture, and the clipped portion alters the p/s ratio through polarization-dependent edge diffraction, so Ψ shows a false 0.2–0.5° offset and thickness results change with where the sample is placed.
units.misconception: 只要偵測器看得到光，樣品高度與傾斜就不會影響 Ψ、Δ。~As long as the detector sees light, sample height and tilt do not affect Ψ and Δ.

units.anchor: 旋轉檢偏鏡傅立葉係數 α、β~Rotating-analyzer Fourier coefficients α and β
units.title: 方位校正與 Ψ、Δ 的求解~Azimuth calibration and the solution for Ψ and Δ
units.mechanism: 旋轉檢偏鏡型（RAE）儀器讓檢偏鏡以固定轉速旋轉，偵測器訊號為 I(A) = I₀[1 + α·cos2A + β·sin2A]，以鎖相或數位傅立葉分析取出正規化係數 α、β。在偏光鏡方位 P 已知時，tanΨ = |tanP|·√((1 + α)/(1 − α))、cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²)。這組公式假設 P 與 A 的零點完全對準，因此建置時要做回歸校正：在多個 P 值下量 α、β，擬合殘差函數找出偏光鏡與檢偏鏡的方位偏置及偵測器衰減係數，再把它們寫進軟體。~A rotating-analyzer ellipsometer (RAE) spins the analyzer at constant speed, and the detector signal is I(A) = I₀[1 + α·cos2A + β·sin2A], with the normalised coefficients α and β extracted by lock-in or digital Fourier analysis. With the polarizer azimuth P known, tanΨ = |tanP|·√((1 + α)/(1 − α)) and cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²). These formulas assume that the zero positions of P and A are exactly aligned, so construction includes a regression calibration: α and β are measured at several P values, a residual function is fitted to extract the polarizer and analyzer azimuth offsets and the detector attenuation factor, and these are written into the software.
units.model: 100 nm SiO₂/Si、70°、632.8 nm、P = 45° 時模型給出 α = −0.137、β = 0.176：tanΨ = √((1 − 0.137)/(1 + 0.137)) = 0.871 → Ψ = 41.06°；cosΔ = 0.176/√(1 − 0.0188) = 0.177 → Δ = 79.79°，與第 2 單元的正向計算一致。注意裸矽的 Δ = 179.2° 落在 cosΔ 的極值附近，δΔ ≈ δβ/sinΔ 被放大約 70 倍，這正是 RAE 需要補償器的原因。~For 100 nm SiO₂/Si at 70°, 632.8 nm and P = 45° the model gives α = −0.137 and β = 0.176: tanΨ = √((1 − 0.137)/(1 + 0.137)) = 0.871 → Ψ = 41.06°; cosΔ = 0.176/√(1 − 0.0188) = 0.177 → Δ = 79.79°, matching the forward calculation of unit 2. Note that bare silicon has Δ = 179.2°, near the extremum of cosΔ, where δΔ ≈ δβ/sinΔ is amplified about 70 times, which is exactly why an RAE needs a compensator.
units.verify: 做直通量測：無樣品時理論上 Ψ = 45°、Δ = 0°；量得的偏差直接給出方位零點與偵測器殘餘偏振靈敏度。再於 P = 20°、30°、45°、60° 各量一片 100 nm 參考片，確認四組 Ψ、Δ 一致在 0.02° 內，否則回歸校正的方位偏置需重做。~Perform a straight-through measurement: with no sample the theory gives Ψ = 45° and Δ = 0°, and any measured deviation yields the azimuth zeros and the residual polarization sensitivity of the detector directly. Then measure a 100 nm reference at P = 20°, 30°, 45° and 60° and confirm that the four Ψ, Δ pairs agree within 0.02°, otherwise the regression-calibrated azimuth offsets must be redone.
units.failure: 檢偏鏡馬達的編碼器與光學軸之間有 0.3° 的裝配偏置而未校正，α、β 的相位旋轉使 Ψ 偏 0.15°、Δ 偏 0.6°，每片薄膜的折射率都被系統性擬合偏高。~An uncalibrated 0.3° assembly offset between the analyzer motor encoder and the optical axis rotates the phase of α and β, biasing Ψ by 0.15° and Δ by 0.6°, so every film's refractive index fits systematically high.
units.misconception: RAE 的公式是純幾何，裝好就能用，不需要任何方位校正。~The RAE equations are pure geometry, so the instrument works as assembled without azimuth calibration.

units.anchor: MSE 擬合與 n–d 相關性~MSE fitting and n–d correlation
units.title: 模型擬合、參數相關性與不確定度~Model fitting, parameter correlation and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 橢偏結果的不確定度不只來自 Ψ、Δ 的雜訊，更多來自模型：厚度 d 與折射率 n 在很薄的膜中高度相關，因為 Δ 的一階變化只取決於 (n² − 1)·d/n² 這類組合，單一波長無法把兩者分開；表面粗糙層、界面層與基板光學常數的選擇也會把誤差推到厚度上。擬合以均方誤差 MSE 衡量，並用參數的 90% 信賴區間與相關矩陣判斷結果是否可信；光譜與多角度資料增加獨立觀測量，是打破相關性的主要手段。~The uncertainty of an ellipsometric result comes less from noise in Ψ and Δ than from the model: thickness d and index n are strongly correlated for very thin films because the first-order change of Δ depends only on a combination such as (n² − 1)·d/n², which a single wavelength cannot separate; choices of surface-roughness layer, interface layer and substrate optical constants likewise push error into the thickness. Fits are judged by the mean-squared error (MSE), and 90% confidence limits and the correlation matrix of the parameters decide whether a result is trustworthy; spectroscopic and multi-angle data add independent observables and are the main way to break the correlation.
units.model: 模型計算：2.00 nm、n = 1.457 的氧化層給 Ψ = 10.618°、Δ = 173.517°；改為 2.10 nm、n = 1.40 得 Ψ = 10.618°、Δ = 173.606°，兩者只差 0.09° 的 Δ 與 0.0004° 的 Ψ，低於一般 0.1° 的雜訊，因此 n 與 d 在原生氧化層上無法同時擬合，標準做法是固定 n = 1.46 只擬合 d。對 100 nm 膜，Ψ 對 d 的靈敏度 0.55°/nm 與對 n 的靈敏度方向不同，相關係數可降到 0.5 以下。~The model shows that a 2.00 nm oxide with n = 1.457 gives Ψ = 10.618°, Δ = 173.517°, while 2.10 nm with n = 1.40 gives Ψ = 10.618°, Δ = 173.606°, differing by only 0.09° in Δ and 0.0004° in Ψ, below a typical 0.1° noise; n and d therefore cannot be fitted together on a native oxide, and standard practice fixes n = 1.46 and fits d only. For a 100 nm film the 0.55°/nm sensitivity of Ψ to d points in a different direction from its sensitivity to n, and the correlation coefficient falls below 0.5.
units.verify: 對同一片 25 nm 氧化層，分別用單波長、300–1000 nm 光譜、以及光譜加三個角度擬合 n 與 d，列出三種情況的相關係數與 90% 信賴區間，確認信賴區間隨觀測量增加而收斂；若加角度後 MSE 反而升高，表示模型缺少某一層（如界面或粗糙層）。~For one 25 nm oxide, fit n and d using a single wavelength, a 300–1000 nm spectrum, and the spectrum plus three angles; tabulate the correlation coefficient and 90% confidence limits for each case and confirm that the limits shrink as observables increase; if adding angles raises the MSE instead, the model is missing a layer such as an interface or roughness layer.
units.failure: 為了讓 MSE 更小而在模型裡同時放開厚度、折射率、粗糙層與基板常數，擬合落到一個物理上不合理但數學上更好的解，報出 n = 1.30 的「氧化層」，後續製程以此調整反而偏離目標。~Freeing thickness, index, roughness and substrate constants together just to lower the MSE drives the fit into a mathematically better but physically meaningless solution, reporting an oxide with n = 1.30, and process adjustments based on it move away from target.
units.misconception: MSE 越小的擬合結果一定越接近真實的薄膜參數。~A fit with a smaller MSE is always closer to the true film parameters.

units.anchor: 應力自由視窗與原位量測~Strain-free viewports and in-situ measurement
units.title: 原位整合、視窗雙折射與對準自動化~In-situ integration, window birefringence and alignment automation
units.mechanism: 把橢偏儀裝到鍍膜或蝕刻腔上做原位量測時，光必須穿過真空視窗，而視窗中的殘餘應力雙折射會對 Δ 加上偏置；應力自由熔融石英視窗與回歸式視窗校正（在腔內放已知樣品、擬合視窗延遲）是標準做法。晶圓廠的量測機台則把樣品對準自動化：四象限偵測器讀取反射光位置、Z 軸自動對焦、R-θ 平台做晶圓圖掃描，並把每一點的對準殘差記錄下來作為資料品質指標。溫度也是整合變數，基板光學常數隨溫度變化會被誤判成厚度。~When an ellipsometer is mounted on a deposition or etch chamber for in-situ measurement, the beam must pass vacuum viewports whose residual stress birefringence adds an offset to Δ; strain-free fused-silica windows plus a regression window calibration (a known sample inside the chamber, fitting the window retardance) are standard practice. Fab metrology tools automate sample alignment: a quadrant detector reads the reflected-beam position, the z axis autofocuses, an R-θ stage scans the wafer map, and the alignment residual at each point is logged as a data-quality indicator. Temperature is also an integration variable, because substrate optical constants changing with temperature can be misread as thickness.
units.model: 視窗若留下 0.5° 的未校正延遲，Δ 就偏 0.5°：對原生氧化層（dΔ/dd = −2.86°/nm）相當於 0.17 nm 的厚度誤差，約為 2 nm 膜厚的 9%；對 100 nm 膜，厚度主要由 Ψ 決定，但 Δ 的 0.5° 偏置會使 MSE 從 1 升到 5 以上，是整合後最先出現的徵兆。校正後的殘餘延遲應低於 0.05°，對應原生氧化層 0.017 nm。~An uncalibrated window retardance of 0.5° biases Δ by 0.5°: for a native oxide (dΔ/dd = −2.86°/nm) that is a 0.17 nm thickness error, about 9% of a 2 nm film; for a 100 nm film the thickness is set mainly by Ψ, but the 0.5° Δ bias raises the MSE from about 1 to above 5, the first symptom after integration. The residual retardance after calibration should be below 0.05°, corresponding to 0.017 nm on a native oxide.
units.verify: 整合前先在桌上量一片 25 nm 參考片，整合後把同一片放進腔內（未鍍膜、室溫）再量一次，兩次 Δ 的差就是視窗延遲；輸入軟體校正後第三次量測的厚度差應小於 0.03 nm。再做 10 次自動對準重複量測，記錄四象限殘差與厚度標準差。~Measure a 25 nm reference wafer on the bench before integration, then place the same wafer in the chamber (uncoated, room temperature) and remeasure; the Δ difference is the window retardance. After entering it into the software a third measurement should agree in thickness within 0.03 nm. Then run 10 automatic-alignment repeats and log the quadrant residuals and the thickness standard deviation.
units.failure: 視窗法蘭鎖得過緊造成應力，雙折射隨腔體溫度循環變化，早上校正好的視窗到下午偏了 0.3°，原位監控的沉積速率曲線出現與製程無關的漂移。~An over-torqued window flange induces stress whose birefringence changes with chamber thermal cycling; a window calibrated in the morning is off by 0.3° by afternoon, and the in-situ deposition-rate curve shows drift unrelated to the process.
units.misconception: 熔融石英視窗是等向性的，所以對橢偏量測完全透明無影響。~Fused-silica viewports are isotropic, so they are completely transparent to ellipsometric measurement.

units.anchor: 參考片與量規 R&R 報告~Reference wafers and gauge R&R record
units.title: 重複性、再現性與機台比對驗收~Repeatability, reproducibility and tool-matching acceptance
units.mechanism: 橢偏儀的交接以量規重複性與再現性（GR&R）為核心：同一片參考片連續量測得到重複性，隔日、換人、重新裝載得到再現性，兩者合成的總變異與製程容差相比得到精度／容差比。多台機台則以同一組參考片做機台比對，要求平均值差異落在容差的一小部分內。驗收報告要列出參考片編號、量測配方（角度、波長範圍、模型）、各項標準差、相關矩陣與校正日期，使後續任何結果都能回溯到這份基準。~Hand-over of an ellipsometer centres on gauge repeatability and reproducibility (GR&R): consecutive measurements of one reference wafer give repeatability, measurements on other days, by other operators and after reloading give reproducibility, and the combined variation compared with the process tolerance gives the precision-to-tolerance ratio. Several tools are matched with the same reference set, requiring mean differences within a small fraction of the tolerance. The acceptance record lists reference-wafer identifiers, the measurement recipe (angle, wavelength range, model), each standard deviation, the correlation matrix and calibration dates, so that every later result traces back to this baseline.
units.model: 100 nm 氧化層參考片：重複性 σ_r = 0.02 nm、再現性 σ_R = 0.03 nm，總量規變異 σ_G = √(0.02² + 0.03²) = 0.036 nm；製程容差 ±0.5 nm（全寬 1.0 nm）時，P/T = 6σ_G/1.0 = 0.22，即 22%，低於常用的 30% 門檻。若兩台機台的平均值差 0.08 nm，佔容差 8%，可接受；差 0.3 nm 則必須重新校正入射角與視窗。~For a 100 nm oxide reference with repeatability σ_r = 0.02 nm and reproducibility σ_R = 0.03 nm, the total gauge variation is σ_G = √(0.02² + 0.03²) = 0.036 nm; with a process tolerance of ±0.5 nm (full width 1.0 nm), P/T = 6σ_G/1.0 = 0.22, i.e. 22%, below the common 30% threshold. A 0.08 nm mean difference between two tools is 8% of tolerance and acceptable; a 0.3 nm difference requires recalibration of angle and windows.
units.verify: 以三片參考片（2、25、100 nm）各做 3 天×3 操作員×10 次的 GR&R 矩陣，用變異數分析拆出重複性與再現性；對每台機台畫出同一片 100 nm 參考片的長期管制圖，任何一週平均漂移超過 0.05 nm 就啟動光源、偏光鏡與角度的複檢。~Run a GR&R matrix of 3 days × 3 operators × 10 repeats on three reference wafers (2, 25 and 100 nm) and separate repeatability from reproducibility by analysis of variance; keep a long-term control chart of the same 100 nm wafer for each tool and trigger a re-check of source, polarizers and angle whenever a weekly mean drifts by more than 0.05 nm.
units.failure: 驗收只用一片 100 nm 參考片，忽略 2 nm 片的 Δ 靈敏區，結果機台在厚膜上互相吻合、在閘極氧化層上卻差 0.2 nm，製程端以為是爐管問題而誤調配方。~Acceptance with a single 100 nm reference ignores the Δ-sensitive 2 nm regime; the tools agree on thick films but differ by 0.2 nm on gate oxides, and the process group misattributes it to the furnace and changes the recipe.
units.misconception: 一台機台的重複性好，就代表它的量測結果準確。~Good repeatability of a tool means its measurements are accurate.

example: SiO₂/Si 建置驗證練習：取 n_SiO₂ = 1.457、n_Si = 3.882 − 0.019i、λ = 632.8 nm、φ = 70°，厚度 d = 100 nm。相位厚度 β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ) = 2π×(100/632.8)×1.1135 = 1.106 rad；以艾里公式分別算 p、s 反射係數並取比值，得 Ψ = 41.06°、Δ = 79.79°。若用旋轉檢偏鏡、P = 45°，預期的傅立葉係數為 α = (tan²Ψ − 1)/(tan²Ψ + 1) = −0.137、β = 2tanΨ·cosΔ/(tan²Ψ + 1) = 0.176；反解 tanΨ = √((1 + α)/(1 − α)) = 0.871、cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²) = 0.177，回到 41.06° 與 79.79°。靈敏度：dΨ/dd = 0.55°/nm，Ψ 解析度 0.01° 對應 0.02 nm；入射角誤差 0.1° 使 Δ 偏 −0.38° 而 Ψ 幾乎不動，擬合 MSE 升高即為警訊。厚度週期 284 nm 表示 100 nm 與 384 nm 在單波長下無法區分，需光譜或多角度。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。~SiO₂/Si construction-check exercise: take n_SiO₂ = 1.457, n_Si = 3.882 − 0.019i, λ = 632.8 nm, φ = 70° and thickness d = 100 nm. The phase thickness is β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ) = 2π×(100/632.8)×1.1135 = 1.106 rad; evaluating the Airy formula for p and s and ratioing gives Ψ = 41.06° and Δ = 79.79°. With a rotating analyzer and P = 45° the expected Fourier coefficients are α = (tan²Ψ − 1)/(tan²Ψ + 1) = −0.137 and β = 2tanΨ·cosΔ/(tan²Ψ + 1) = 0.176; inverting, tanΨ = √((1 + α)/(1 − α)) = 0.871 and cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²) = 0.177, returning 41.06° and 79.79°. Sensitivity: dΨ/dd = 0.55°/nm, so 0.01° in Ψ resolves 0.02 nm; a 0.1° angle error shifts Δ by −0.38° while Ψ barely moves, and the rising fit MSE is the warning sign. The 284 nm thickness period means 100 nm and 384 nm are indistinguishable at one wavelength, so spectroscopic or multi-angle data are required. All values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 德魯德在 1887–1890 年間推導出反射偏振理論並以此量測金屬上的薄膜，是橢偏術的起點；1945 年 Rothen 建造了第一台以此命名的「橢偏儀」。1975 年 Aspnes 與 Studna 發表自動化旋轉檢偏鏡橢偏儀，使 Ψ、Δ 能以電子方式快速取得；1980–90 年代光譜型與可變角度儀器商品化（J.A. Woollam 於 1987 年成立、法國 SOPRA、美國 Rudolph 等），橢偏儀隨後成為半導體廠閘極氧化層與多層膜的例行量測工具。本課重建的是公開的物理與建置邏輯，不涉及任何廠商的專有演算法。~Drude derived the theory of reflected polarization between 1887 and 1890 and used it to measure thin films on metals, the origin of ellipsometry; in 1945 Rothen built the first instrument to carry the name ellipsometer. In 1975 Aspnes and Studna published the automated rotating-analyzer ellipsometer, making Ψ and Δ available electronically and quickly; spectroscopic and variable-angle instruments were commercialised in the 1980s and 1990s (J.A. Woollam founded in 1987, SOPRA in France, Rudolph in the United States), and ellipsometers then became routine tools for gate oxides and multilayer stacks in semiconductor fabs. This course reconstructs public physics and construction logic, not any vendor's proprietary algorithm.
